Pay Per Lead for Jewelers

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers who need customers looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or purchase an engagement ring. The first three leads are free, and each accepted lead costs $40, with an optional valuation widget available for $29 per month.

How the Pay‑Per‑Lead Model Works

CaratBase connects you with people actively searching for jewelry services in your metro area. Leads are pre‑screened for intent, ensuring you spend time only on prospects ready to engage. You receive each lead instantly via email or your preferred CRM, and you only pay when the lead converts into a qualified opportunity.

What You Get with CaratBase

  • Verified Local Leads – Real people in your service area looking to buy, sell, or appraise jewelry.
  • No Up‑Front Account Commitment – Start receiving leads immediately after the free trial; you only pay for accepted leads.
  • U.S. Focus – Leads are sourced from across the United States, beginning with the Atlanta metro and expanding to other regions.
  • Optional Valuation Widget – Add a custom appraisal tool to your website for $29 per month, helping visitors get instant estimates and increasing lead quality.

Why Choose CaratBase

  • Cost‑Effective – Pay only for leads that meet your criteria; there are no hidden fees or monthly minimums beyond the optional widget.
  • Time‑Saving – Skip cold calling and generic advertising; each lead arrives ready to discuss your services.
  • Scalable – As you grow, CaratBase expands its coverage to additional metros, giving you a steady pipeline of new customers.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many free leads can I try? You receive the first three verified leads at no charge, allowing you to test the quality and conversion rate before committing.

What happens after the free leads? Each accepted lead costs $40. You are billed only for leads you confirm as qualified, so you maintain full control over your spend.

Can I add the valuation widget to my site? Yes. For $29 per month you can embed a valuation widget that lets visitors receive instant appraisals, driving more qualified traffic to your business.

Next Step

Ready to start generating qualified jewelry leads? Visit the Pay‑Per‑Lead page at caratbase.com/pay-per-lead-jewelers and claim your three free leads today.
